author: ThomasCosme
quote:
NO.


You’d expect the MOST ANTICIPATED GAME IN HISTORY to atleast allow you to enjoy it right outside the box, this is literally the purpose of EVERY SINGLE VIDEO GAME, to be ENTERTAINING.
Instead, you pay $99.99 ******* dollars only to find that cheats are locked behind the full 91-mission campaign, and the game actively punishes you for trying to mess around.
I would understand the restrictions if THEY were paying you to play the game, but YOU’RE the one paying the 100 dollars, YOU should be the one enjoying the game, yet for some stupid reason, it’s the other way around. 

EVEN AFTER you beat all 91 missions, cheats aren't just handed to you, you literally have to MANUALLY UNLOCK the cheats like a maid being paid, but let’s keep in mind YOU’RE the one paying.

To add insult to the injury, roughly a quarter of the quote and quote “cheats” are actually just visual screen filters. 

Meanwhile, a $30 game like Minecraft gives you complete, unrestricted freedom from the very first second. GTA 6 might look realistic, but what’s the point of realism if it’s not fun? By locking away basic sandbox fun behind a massive chore list, Rockstar forgot what actually makes a video game fun to play.

We asked for a video game, not another real life. Until Rockstar remembers what made GTA fun in the first place and gives players ACTUAL FREEDOM, like what you SHOULD get for 100 dollars, SAVE YOUR MONEY.


DO NOT BUY THIS, PLEASE.
